The report now shows `REORDER` for any item whose stock on hand is less than 6 days of average sales; `OUT` still means the shelf is empty. The 6 is `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` at the top of `stock_report.py`.

Running it on your current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has 9 against the 14.4 it would sell in 6 days, and oat milk has 30 against 45.

Because the report runs nightly, an item is flagged the first night it dips under 6 days of cover. By then it may have only 5-and-a-bit days left, so the shelf can still be empty for up to a day before delivery. The same happens if sales run above the 30-day average. Setting `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8 gives you that cushion, or I can add a separate safety-days setting if you'd rather keep the 6 as the true supplier figure.
